title: Variant swap during capacity spill caused cross-region spiraling reroutes - mitigation & action items
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Summary: A capacity spill event on 2026-03-01 triggered an incorrect model-variant swap in the smart-routing decision path for a subset of customers. That swap combined with cross-region retry logic created a spiraling reroute pattern for ~3% of requests over a 27-minute window, increasing tail latency and causing coherent inference failures for latency-sensitive routes. This ticket captures the incident follow-ups, immediate mitigations, telemetry gaps, and long-term fixes required to prevent recurrence.
timeline: 2026-03-01T10:13Z - Spike in capacity usage (eu-west-1) observed; autoscaler triggered spill to standby pools.
2026-03-01T10:15Z - Smart-routing policy cache expired during the spill; stale policy snapshot used by edge proxies.
2026-03-01T10:18Z - Several requests experienced variant metadata mismatch; routing layer chose an incompatible lower-capacity variant causing fallback and immediate cross-region retry.
2026-03-01T10:25Z - Monitoring alert: increased route oscillation and error-rate in impacted customers (alert-routing-oscillation-prod fired).
2026-03-01T10:40Z - On-call mitigations applied: manual hotspot blacklist for affected pool, temporary strict-region routing for critical customers.
2026-03-01T11:00Z - Traffic stabilized after manual interventions and adjusted autoscaler thresholds; follow-up postmortem initiated.
2026-03-03T09:00Z - Initial RCA draft completed and reviewed with SRE, Routing, and Serving teams.
2026-03-12T14:30Z - This ticket created to track action items and owner assignments following RCA review.
root_cause: A race between autoscaler-driven capacity spill and policy-cache refresh coupled with the routing decision logic lacking an explicit variant-compatibility check. When a server pool spilled, a stale policy snapshot referencing a different model-variant (incompatible quantization/profile) was applied by edge routers; requests were routed to a variant that could not satisfy the expected kv-cache/kv-format, triggering fallbacks and causing cascading cross-region retries that amplified oscillation.
mitigations_applied: Immediate: Blacklisted the impacted standby pool to prevent re-routes to the incompatible variant (manual action by on-call) - 2026-03-01.
Immediate: Enforced strict-region routing for top 10 latency-sensitive accounts until rollout of compatibility guard - 2026-03-01.
Short-term: Raised autoscaler spill threshold to reduce churn during high short-lived bursts - temporary config change.
Monitoring: Added ad-hoc Grafana panels showing variant mismatch rate and region-to-region retry churn.
Communications: Customer support notifications and SLO hit summary distributed to affected accounts.
action_items: ENG-34789-A1: Implement variant-compatibility check in routing decision path (reject route if metadata mismatch) — owner: Marco Ruiz — due: 2026-03-18.
ENG-34789-A2: Add atomic policy cache swap with versioned config and validation (no partial snapshots) — owner: Priya Sharma — due: 2026-03-25.
ENG-34789-A3: Add canary gating for autoscaler spill behavior and reduce aggressive spill windows — owner: SRE Team (lead: Daniel Kim) — due: 2026-03-22.

ENG-34789-A4: Expand telemetry: instrument per-request variant-id and kv-format headers in traces and make variant-mismatch a first-class metric — owner: Observability (lead: Jia Li) — due: 2026-03-20.
ENG-34789-A5: Create automated test harness that injects stale-policy snapshots during failover scenarios to validate routing invariant — owner: Runtime QA (lead: Omar Hassan) — due: 2026-04-02.
ENG-34789-A6: Update runbooks: add steps to identify variant-mismatch, emergency pool-blacklist workflow, and customer rollback path — owner: SRE (lead: Daniel Kim) — due: 2026-03-15.
ENG-34789-A7: Post-incident customer review and SLA remediation planning for impacted accounts — owner: Customer Success (lead: Elena Novak) — due: 2026-03-30.
ENG-34789-A8: Add fallback-rate SLO and dashboard (alert when >0.5% sustained mismatch) — owner: Observability — due: 2026-03-26.
ENG-34789-A9: Run a focused capacity soak in eu-west-1 to validate autoscaler and routing interplay — owner: Capacity Infra — due: 2026-04-05.
ENG-34789-A10: Post-deploy verification checklist for runtime-1.19 that includes variant metadata compatibility smoke tests — owner: Release Engineering — due: 2026-03-29.
ENG-34789-A11: Follow-up retrospective to evaluate whether policy publishing cadence should be throttled during major autoscaling events — owner: Product (lead: Maya Chen) — due: 2026-03-28.

resolution_summary: Short-term mitigation stabilized traffic by blacklisting the incompatible standby pool and temporarily tightening autoscaler spill thresholds. Root cause is a race between capacity spill and policy cache refresh combined with missing variant-compatibility validation. Priority deliverables are a routing-level compatibility gate, atomic policy publish, improved telemetry, and test harnesses for failover scenarios. Owners assigned; implementation work in progress with a target release in runtime-1.19 and validation runbook updates before rollout.
